Definition: Chul, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him
BiblicalUsage: Hul is a son of Aram, named in the table of nations, and the region settled by his descendants carries his name. The name appears twice, both times in lists of the sons of Shem. Nothing is told of his life, and the land is his only memorial.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hul is remembered because the nations themselves are part of God's story, and every people has a place in His book.
